layers.note: A coarse, bushy grass of desert flats and sandy ground.

moisture.note: Sand, depressions and heavy alluvial soils (FEIS).

elevation_m.note: Below 1,200 m in Arizona (FEIS); up to 4,000 feet (Kearney and Peebles).

shade_tolerance.note: Full sun; shaded out by chollas taller than 70 cm (FEIS).

coldest_c.note: Across its range, coldest-month means from about 3 to 15 °C; gone below 0 °C and above 18 °C.

hard_freeze_c.note: Across its range, lows to about −12 °C borne, gone where the year's coldest night falls below about −16 °C.

warmest_c.note: Across its range, warmest-month means from about 27 to 36 °C; gone below 24 °C, where summers are too short, and above 39 °C.

degree_days_0.note: About 5,000 to 12,000 degree-days above 0 °C, none below 4,000.

degree_days_5.note: About 3,300 to 10,000 degree-days above 5 °C, none below 2,500.

moisture_index.note: A moisture index from about 0.03 to 0.25, gone by 0.01 and above 0.35.

summer_rain.note: No lower limit: it also grows where winter rain dominates, as in the Mojave Desert; where the monsoon brings summer rain, as on the bajada, up to about 0.6 of the year's precipitation in summer, gone by 0.75.

provenance.notes: Authored for the Saguaro desert scene (the west bajada of Saguaro National Park's Tucson Mountain District, about 750 m, 32.25 N 111.17 W) from general knowledge of the species and the ranges, habitats and elevations in the sources read for its spec (2026-10-19). Big galleta grows from southern Utah and Nevada to southern California, western Arizona and Sonora, the Mojave and lower Colorado River deserts at its heart (FEIS, as Pleuraphis rigida; Kearney and Peebles, who do not list Pima County). Each climate range brackets the climate of that range, an approximate envelope read from these descriptions, not fitted to occurrence records; every full range holds the bajada's climate (coldest month about 11 °C, warmest about 31 °C, about 7,600 degree-days above 0 °C, coldest night about −4 °C, moisture index about 0.15, about half the year's rain in summer).
